Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

JmespathProjectionError.description: Returned when a REST jmespath projection is invalid or exceeds the expression/output byte limits.

original_keys.description: Top-level keys or shape of the unprojected response.

ListPredictionMarketsRequest.description: ListPredictionMarketsRequest specifies filters for retrieving prediction markets.

cursor.description:
Cursor for next page.
 Accepted but currently ignored; no-op until this handler supports the parameter.

minLiquidity.description:
Optional minimum liquidity (resting order-book depth in USD). When above 0,
 only markets with liquidity at or above this value are returned; markets
 without a liquidity value are dropped. Applied before page_size.

query.description: Optional search query for market titles.

ListPredictionMarketsResponse.description: ListPredictionMarketsResponse contains prediction markets matching the request.

dataAvailable.description:
True when markets were evaluated against a seed snapshot. False means an
 empty payload is graceful degradation because the snapshot is unavailable.

fetchedAt.description:
Time the seed snapshot was fetched, as Unix epoch milliseconds. A value of
 0 means the snapshot is unavailable/degraded, not that there are confirmed
 zero matching markets.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

PaginationResponse.description: PaginationResponse contains pagination metadata returned alongside list results.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for fetching the next page. Empty string indicates no more pages.

totalCount.description: Total count of items matching the query, if known. Zero if the total is unknown.

PredictionMarket.description: PredictionMarket represents a prediction market contract.

closesAt.description: Market close time, as Unix epoch milliseconds. Zero if no expiry.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

liquidity.description:
Resting order-book depth in USD, measured per venue: Polymarket CLOB
 liquidity, or the sum of price times size over every Kalshi yes and no bid.
 Absent when the venue reports none or the order book could not be fetched.

source.description: Source platform for prediction market data.

yesPriceChange24h.description: Upstream 24-hour Yes price change on the probability scale. Absent if unavailable.

yesPriceChange7d.description: Upstream 7-day Yes price change on the probability scale. Polymarket only.

ValidationError.description: ValidationError is returned when request validation fails. It contains a list of field violations describing what went wrong.

get.description:
ListPredictionMarkets retrieves active prediction markets from seeded market snapshots.
 Empty markets with fetched_at=0 or data_available=false means the seed
 snapshot is unavailable/degraded, not that there are confirmed zero markets.

parameters.description:
Cursor for next page.
 Accepted but currently ignored; no-op until this handler supports the parameter.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Optional search query for market titles.
parameters.name: query

Optional minimum liquidity (resting order-book depth in USD). When above 0,
 only markets with liquidity at or above this value are returned; markets
 without a liquidity value are dropped. Applied before page_size.
parameters.name: min_liquidity

parameters.description: Optional JMESPath expression applied server-side to project or reduce the JSON response before it is returned (mirrors the MCP jmespath argument). Invalid expressions, expressions larger than 1024 UTF-8 bytes, or projections that exceed the 256 KB output cap return HTTP 400 with a {_jmespath_error, original_keys} envelope. Grammar and worked examples: https://www.worldmonitor.app/docs/mcp-jmespath.
parameters.name: jmespath
